resources.string: The pump has records the app does not know (type %1$s). Doses may be missing from the journal: check the pump\'s history and share the pump link journal.
Pump: bolus or meal not read
A bolus or meal record of type %1$s could not be read. Check the pump\'s history and add the dose to the journal by hand if it is missing.
Boluses and meals from before Permanent operation was turned on were found. Open the pump window and choose whether to write them to the journal.
The pump has not reported how much of a bolus was delivered. Check the delivered amount on the pump.
The pump\'s clock differs from the phone\'s. Set the time on the pump, otherwise the journal times may be off.
The pump is no longer among the phone\'s paired Bluetooth devices, so its data cannot come. Open the pump window and pair again.
Pump: turn Bluetooth off and on now

Otherwise the phone may erase the pump\'s pairing. Another app (for example, OMRON connect) got hold of Bluetooth before JugglucoNGmod. The pump may connect any minute, even though the app does not call it; then it may get stuck on that app, and after 30 seconds the phone erases the pairing. The sensor and the watch drop off for a moment.
OMRON connect may get in the pump\'s way
If OMRON connect\'s Bluetooth server gets in before ours, the pump may get stuck on it, and the phone erases its pairing. Add OMRON connect to the deep sleeping apps in the phone\'s battery settings.
Urgent: the phone may erase the pump\'s pairing
